description: This bar chart illustrates the F1 Score (%) achieved by four variants of the MADLLM model across six different datasets: SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI. The horizontal axis, labeled "Dataset," lists these datasets in left-to-right order. The vertical axis, labeled "F1 Score (%)", ranges from 60 to 100 in increments of 10, indicating the performance metric in percentage. For each dataset, four colored bars represent the performance of different model configurations: green for "MADLLM", purple for "MADLLM w/o feature embedding", blue for "MADLLM w/o prompt pool", and orange for "MADLLM w/o skip embedding". In the SMD dataset, the green bar reaches approximately 94%, the purple bar is slightly lower at about 92%, the blue bar is around 91%, and the orange bar is also near 91%. For the PSM dataset, the green bar is the highest at approximately 98%, followed by the purple bar at about 97%, the blue bar at around 78%, and the orange bar at approximately 97%. In the SWaT dataset, the green bar is about 91%, the purple bar is slightly lower at around 90%, the blue bar is approximately 82%, and the orange bar is around 85%. For the SMAP dataset, the green bar is approximately 93%, the purple bar is around 70%, the blue bar is about 70%, and the orange bar is around 67%. In the MSL dataset, the green bar is approximately 88%, the purple bar is around 86%, the blue bar is about 70%, and the orange bar is around 85%. For the WADI dataset, the green bar is approximately 74%, the purple bar is around 62%, the blue bar is about 63%, and the orange bar is around 68%. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the datasets. There are no visual emphasis or annotations beyond the color-coded legend.
